title: fix(plugin-form): a record dialog's collapsed section opens in place, not behind the console's loading screen (objectui#12559)
body:
Fixes #12559
Clause-②: no

## What was wrong

The field widgets `@object-ui/fields` registers are `React.lazy`: a type's chunk is fetched the first time a form draws it, and that first render suspends. A section that starts collapsed keeps its fields out of the DOM, so the click that opens it is often the first render of a type (currency, url, address). Nothing inside `ModalForm` caught that suspension, so it landed on the host's nearest `Suspense`. The console mounts the record dialog beside its routes (`AppContent`, after the route `ErrorBoundary`), so the nearest boundary is `ConsoleShell`'s root one around the whole app: the whole console, dialog included, was swapped for the root fallback while the chunk loaded. The full-page create route sits inside the route's own boundary and hid only its page.

## Producer, with evidence

- **Named:** an unbounded lazy-widget suspension inside the dialog body escaping to the host's root boundary.
- **Not the two triage candidates.** The collapse state is `ModalForm`'s own `useState` (`collapsedSections`), below the dialog; the console's key for the dialog is the object name plus the record id or `new`, which a toggle cannot change. The section header is a `div` with `role="button"` drawn by the form renderer's `SectionDivider`, not a submit button (PM assumption A2 disproved). A toggled value wins over the declared one in `resolveSectionCollapse` (`host.live ?? declared`), and the new pin re-renders the host with a fresh schema object to hold that (A3).
- **A1 measured, half confirmed.** The skeleton is the dialog leaving the screen. In a Chromium harness (React 19, real `ModalForm`, a root `Suspense` above it, no route boundary between, served by the console's Vite at 1440x900): right after the header click the host fallback mounted and the dialog's computed `display` was `none`; 200 ms later the fallback had unmounted and the dialog came back with the section expanded and the typed value kept. In that harness React kept `ModalForm`'s state.
- **NOT MEASURED: the console-only remount** (dialog comes back collapsed, card body). It did not reproduce without the console's ancestors, and HotCRM needs a backend this container cannot boot cheaply. With this change the root boundary is never reached, so whatever above it reacted to the fallback is no longer triggered. The landing seat's HotCRM Leads → New reading is the confirmation.

## The fix

`ModalForm` owns its body's wait, the same shape `FlowRunner` gives its screen body (framework#3528 precedent, pinned by `FlowRunner.suspense.test.tsx`). Both dialog bodies (the stacked/tabbed form and the master-detail one) render inside a `Suspense` whose fallback is `ModalFormBodyPending`. The header and footer stay on screen, and the form underneath is hidden, not unmounted. It is distinct from `modal-form-skeleton`, which stays the record read's loading state. The first open of a dialog whose types are not loaded yet is covered the same way.

A first attempt put a boundary around every registered field widget in the form renderer (`packages/components` `form.tsx`). I reverted it inside this branch: it changed the readiness contract of every form in the product (labels drawn before their controls), and `tabbedFormSectionPredicate-6237` went red on it. The defect belongs to an overlay that a host mounts outside its page boundary. `form.tsx` is byte-equal to main.

## Pins (`packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/modalSectionToggleSuspense-12559.test.tsx`)

The host is the console's shape: a root `Suspense` whose fallback counts its mounts, a host that mints a mount id once, and `ModalForm` under a stable key, handed a fresh schema object every render. The `url` widget is swapped for one whose chunk lands only on release.

1. Header click on a collapsed section: mid-load the host fallback does not mount, the dialog stays shown with its title, and the body placeholder is inside it. After release: one host mount, one `getObjectSchema` call, no read skeleton, the section expanded with its fields, and the value typed in the other section kept.
2. The toggled state is the dialog's: a host re-render with a fresh schema keeps the section open.
3. CONTROL: a section that starts expanded still collapses.
4. CONTROL: the full-page form (`ObjectForm`, simple) still expands a collapsed section.

**Ablation** (via `ablation-replace.mjs`, mutation proven on disk and restored, `git diff HEAD` empty): with the body `Suspense` removed, pin 1 goes RED at the host-fallback count (`expected 2 to be 1`), and pins 2-4 stay green. A first ablation attempt was refused by the tool as a no-op (the replacement text already occurred as a substring) and is not counted. Under jsdom React keeps state across the hide, so the remount half of pin 1 stays green even under ablation. The pin that fails is "the host's boundary never takes the dialog off screen".

`sectionedFormValues.test.tsx` used the footer as its readiness signal. The footer now draws while the body waits, so the test also waits for the body placeholder to go before it counts `form` elements.

## Gates (final head `cc9467aed`, unless noted)

- Closure build `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/plugin-form^...' build`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-form type-check` (tsc + `tsconfig.test.json`; `--listFiles` includes the new test): exit 0 at `276d22c17`. The only later change in this package is a test file, which the targeted run below covers.
- Targeted vitest, the 29 plugin-form test files that mention `ModalForm`, `section-divider` or `collaps`, plus the pin: `29 passed, 393 tests` at `cc9467aed`.
- `vitest run packages/plugin-form/` at `276d22c17`: 184 of 185 files passed. The one red was `sectionedFormValues` (above), fixed and re-run green at `cc9467aed`. The full directory was not re-run on the final head.
- Narrowed lint on the two changed source files (eslint config: `**/*.{ts,tsx}`; 2 files per `--format json`; no type-aware linting configured, so the diff cannot move any untouched file's verdict): 0 errors. `ModalForm.tsx` has 20 warnings, the same as main.
- Pre-tsc battery (phantom-deps, self-import, unreferenced-sources, doc-example-readers, handler-key-reads, side-effects-array, element-data-source-declaration, spec-symbols, action-forward-parity, designer-field-key-parity, icon-record-names, i18n-keys, i18n-drift, i18n-designer-parity, control-bytes, new-line-citations, test-path-roots), `check-hand-rolled-comment-mask`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major`: all exit 0.
- NOT MEASURED, declared to CI: `packages/app-shell/` (an app-shell full run held the shared lock for over 30 minutes) and the browser reading on HotCRM.

## Acceptance notes

- Same class, not changed here: any other overlay that mounts a form outside its host's page boundary inherits the lazy-widget suspension. `DrawerForm` and the record detail drawer were not audited. The per-widget boundary in the form renderer would close the whole class, at the cost of the readiness change above. That is a design call for the maintainer, not this card. Carrier: none.
- Serial: #12556 (objectui#12548) and #12546 had not landed at the last merge of `origin/main`. This diff touches only the dialog body wrapper and the end of `ModalForm.tsx`, not the section layout code those PRs edit.
